verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a GPU. However, the only memory specs in evidence are 16 GB of VRAM on a 256-bit bus with 960 GB/s of GDDR7 bandwidth. That is half the 5090's memory and well short of what a 70B-class quantized model needs to fit on a single card. Vendor claims about running 'the latest AI models locally' and Ollama/PyTorch support are generic and never claim 70B-class capability, so they earn no credit for this story.
